brief:
An Israeli military attack on Khan Younis in southern Gaza wounded at least nine Palestinians, including children, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported according to Middle East Eye. The injured were evacuated and received medical treatment following the strike in the densely populated area of the southern Gaza Strip.

The incident marks the latest in a series of military operations affecting civilian populations in Khan Younis, a city that has experienced repeated Israeli military action. No immediate details were provided regarding the specific target or circumstances surrounding the attack.
